2556-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2556-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5034-5315-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5034-5315-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

539-728-2452-3249--56.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-2452-3249--56.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the Zombie card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2783-2841-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-6798-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6798-7173.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2558-5226-7916.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

2073-5231-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-5231-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

796-1618-2440-2806.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher
796-1618-2440-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
796-1618-2440-2806.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

206-240-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

3110-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1739-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

57-2341-4846-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-2341-4846-7060.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

874-2438-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2438-2866-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

777-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

567-1274-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-1274-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-6472.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Deceptive Frostkite.
1621-6472.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Deceptive Frostkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Deceptive Frostkite. Choose to have Deceptive Frostkite enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1913-2073-5330--90.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2842-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2842-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

586-5004-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
586-5004-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Cathodion and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1575-3698-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-3698-4231.description:

When the tokens enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers three times, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1575-4231-5226.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1940-4191-5010-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

228-678-2459-3701.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Rograkh dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1218-2390-3372.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
1218-2390-3372.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature until end of turn.
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving All Will Be One +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4.

900-1550-2239-2489.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine attached to any other creature without summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with the Swords attached.
900-1550-2239-2489.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine trigger.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, blinking Ardent Elementalist and causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield.
Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sword of Feast and Famine trigger, causing you to untap all lands you control, and causing the defending player to discard a card.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
 Repeat.
